notes: PROPOSED: Settings > Clean-up and Settings > Models now have Add a key, a key list and Check this key. Keys you add in Dictum are kept in Windows Credential Manager. You can keep several keys for a service and choose which one to use. Check this key sends the key to that service only when you press it, after consent; it sends nothing you dictated or wrote. Create the key file now includes the full template, and the Help page on the website has guides for getting and adding keys. Settings > Privacy can remove all keys you added in Dictum. Calibration now confirms when Use this takes effect and marks the row In use; with cloud speech on, it says the chosen model is the fallback. The voice activity gate model file is downloaded only with Dictum.exe --download-model silero-v6.2.0.
